facts: FTX began operating around the beginning of May 2019.
FTX replaced Auth0 with an entirely in-house authentication and login form system.
FTX added support for 11 different fiat currencies over its first year, including the newly added Brazilian Real (BRL).
FTX is giving away an FTX x HTC phone with a built-in cold wallet to a random person depositing at least $1,000 of fiat during the anniversary week.
missing: The specific name or identifier of the industry-standard database system that suffered from memory allocation issues.
The exact date when the in-house login form and Brazilian Real support were released.
fixes: In the sentence "One is that we just didn’t have total control over what you could do on the login form.", add the exact launch date of the new login system.
In the sentence "The only real, permanent solution is to stop using this industry-standard database system entirely, and build our own.", add the name of the database system.
In the sentence "Today, we’re excited to announce one new member of the FTX fiat family: Brazilian Real (BRL).", add the specific launch date.
